ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/tan) pixels concentrated in discrete circular patterns and heavy clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity tan/white clusters localized at the far left and right tips; discrete white circular rings and small punctate spots scattered across the dark central and lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 110-120 degrees and moderate depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations and jagged pixel-amplitude variations across the entire continuous boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on both lobes, sweeping upward and tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white circular ring-shaped pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; concentrated clusters of tan/white calcified organisms (barnacles) on both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Isolated white linear streaks and faint scratches visible on the lower central region and across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips; widespread circular scarring from historical parasitic attachment; distinct jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme accumulation of calcified growth on the distal edges creates a significant, high-contrast textural boundary against the water background.
